name: concept
description: A concept package (K2): `atlas new concept <slug>` overlays these files on the base scaffold. explainer.ts declares type 'concept' (routed at /train/<slug>/), lesson.ts is the primary path, concept.ts holds the page around it (hook, toy, real, compare, pitfalls, further) and concept.test.ts lints it. Not a model template: `new model --template concept` is refused.
